summary: What the numbers mean when writing effect and instrument settings (own units, not the UI's display)
body: Settings take each parameter's own units, the catalog's range: dB for levels (wet, dry, volume: -96..0), Hz for frequencies, seconds for envelope times, 0..1 for most percentages (feedback, mix, depth, sustain), -1..1 for bipolar ones (filter, pan, slope), and an index for stepped ones (a delay time, an algorithm, a waveform, a filter slope).

Stepped indices count from 0 in the catalog's value list: Revamp's lowPass/order 0..3 is 12/24/36/48 dB; Vaporisateur's oscillator waveform 0..3 is Sine/Triangle/Sawtooth/Square; Crusher's bits is the bit count itself (1..16).
A value outside the range is brought back in by TakeDo's guard (one out-of-range value once crashed the audio engine).
